chunks: He (peace be upon him) said in one of his speeches:
A ruler came into position over them. He remained upright and made them upright till the entire religion put its bosom on the ground.
ai.seo_question: What is the effect of a righteous ruler on the establishment of religion according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this passage from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) illustrates the transformative power of a divinely appointed leader (Wali) whose personal steadfastness ensures the stability of the community. The metaphor of religion 'striking its pegs' (daraba al-din bi-jiranih) signifies that true religious authority is not merely theoretical but is practically anchored in the social and political fabric, a concept central to Shia political theology regarding the necessity of just governance for the preservation of faith.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 467. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said in one of his speeches:
A ruler came into position over them. He remained upright and made them upright till the entire religion put its bosom on the ground.
